_note: Crash Lab Layer 1: direct attacks on the checker. Each step is sent straight to submit_payment(), in order, on a fresh audit log. 'submitted_at' is the real time a step was sent when it differs from the time the request claims. Expected answers follow the policy's intent, not what the code does today. All companies, people, and accounts are fictional.
status: DRAFT written by Claude. The owner reviews it and moves it to crash_lab/expected/ by hand.

scenarios.description: MADE-UP AGENT IDS: three $100,000 payments, each claiming to come from a different agent
